title: Wintersaber Trainers
wikitext:
===Introduction===

[[Alliance]] only [[Faction|faction]].

This faction has two NPC (Updated or corrected by [[User:Cutekangaroo|Parasol]], depending if at one time if [[Chal Fairwind]] [http://www.thottbot.com/?n=443521 (TB)] existed or not). Currently, only [[Rivern Frostwind]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=10618 (Allakhazam)] gives quests. He is located in [[Winterspring]] on the top of [[Frostsaber Rock]].
If you are [[Exalted]] with this [[faction]], you can buy a special [[mount]] from him, the [[Winterspring Frostsaber]] [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?i=25287 (TB)].
For any of the other races besides [[Night Elf]], you will also need to be [[Exalted]] with [[Darnassus]] in order to learn [[Tiger Riding]] [http://www.thottbot.com/index.cgi?sp=6745 (TB)].

===Getting Faction===

[[Rivern Frostwind]] offers three quests. You gain fifty Reputations Points for each turn-in so you must do the quests a total of 840 times to get the [[mount]].

The first quest, [[Frostsaber Provisions]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?wquest=4970 (Allakhazam)], is avalaible at level 58. It requires five [[Shardtooth Meat]] from the [[Elder Shardtooths]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7445 (Allakhazam)] and five [[Chillwind Meat]] from the [[Chillwind Ravagers]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7449 (Allakhazam)].

The second quest, [[Winterfall Intrusion]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?wquest=5201 (Allakhazam)], is avaliable after gaining 1500 Points (halfway to friendly). You need to kill five [[Winterfall Shamans]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7439 (Allakhazam)] and five [[Winterfall Ursas]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7438 (Allakhazam)] located in [[Winterfall Village]], east of [[Everlook]]. This will also give reputation points for [[Timbermaw Furbolgs]] faction.

The third quest, [[Rampaging Giants]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?wquest=5981 (Allakhazam)], is an elite quest and is avaliable when you get [[Honored]]. You need to kill four [[Frostmaul Giants]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7428 (Allakhazam)] and four [[Frostmaul Preservers]] [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/mob.html?wmob=7429 (Allakhazam)] located in [[Dark Whispergorge]] in southern [[Winterspring]].

==Personal Advice==
[[Image:Wintersaber_tiger.jpg|thumb|Crazy Human on Mount... Me --[[User:Colenzo|Colenzo]] 05:44, 17 Aug 2005 (EDT)]]
Mostly from [[User:Colenzo|Colenzo]]:
:''Do the first Quest 30 times and then only the second one, its the best (especially because you can raise reputation for 2 factions at the same time) not to try to do the third quest.''
:''Don't care about the Frostsabers attacking you near the Rock, simply run through and try not to die.''
:''It's great if are able to [[Mining|Mine]], since there are lots of rich Thorium spots.''
:''Try to get somebody to do it together (except for the first 30 times), since it is faster and not so boring.''
:''Try to get some good music if you must do it alone.''
:''Don't care about people camping in Winterfall, you have to be there too long to remember them all... simply go ahead, they will vanish.''
